'''Premiere - A New Hope Sealed''' is a sealed league format on [[GEMP]] built from [[Premiere]] and [[A New Hope]] product. Its format definition uses Premiere and A New Hope (set ids 1&ndash;2) and premium ids 101&ndash;103.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" /> GEMP's sealed league type ''Premiere - A New Hope Sealed'' uses this format.<ref name="sealedtype" />

* '''Type:''' sealed deck (GEMP sealed league)
* '''Defined by:''' play.swccg.com format; league type from the Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' Premiere and A New Hope product (one Jedi Pack, an [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]], Premiere and A New Hope boosters), 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Premiere - A New Hope Sealed'' (<code>premiere_anh_sealed</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the league type ''Premiere-A New Hope Sealed'' is played under the generic [[Sealed]] format<ref name="pc-slt" />

== Card pool ==
Players build decks from the product their sealed league gives them. A league has two series; a player who joins gets the product of every series that has started, and every player gets each later series' product when it starts.<ref name="nsld" /><ref name="slp" />

On play.swccg.com the league issues:<ref name="slp" />
* '''Series 1:''' 1 Jedi Pack, 1 [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]], 4 Premiere Booster Packs and 1 A New Hope Booster Pack, plus 10 fixed cards: Dark Side ''Death Star: Docking Control Room 327'', ''Vader'', ''Vader's Obsession'', ''Tentacle'' and ''There'll Be Hell To Pay''; Light Side ''Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor'', ''Luke'', ''Run Luke, Run!'', ''Grappling Hook'' and ''What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?''.<ref name="slp" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* '''Series 2:''' 2 Premiere Booster Packs and 4 A New Hope Booster Packs.<ref name="slp" />
The Official Tournament Sealed Deck itself holds 4 Premiere Booster Packs, 1 A New Hope Booster Pack and the cards of the Official Tournament Sealed Deck set (GEMP set 106).<ref name="k-OfficialTournamentSealedDeck" /> The Players Committee code issues 2 Official Tournament Sealed Decks in series 1 instead; both come to 8 Premiere and 2 A New Hope Booster Packs.<ref name="slp" /><ref name="pc-slp" /> The full contents of each product are listed at [[GEMP sealed league products]].

The format definition allows only Premiere and A New Hope (set ids 1&ndash;2) and premium ids 101&ndash;103. It sets a deck size of 40 cards and marks the format as not a game hall format, so it is played through its league rather than at open tables.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" />

=== Special rule ===
The GEMP format definitions list this special rule:<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="hall" />
* Once per game, a player may ▼ a unique battleground not already on table.

== History ==
The league type comes from the Players Committee GEMP code, which plays it under the generic [[Sealed]] format. play.swccg.com gave it its own format with the same name, the only GEMP sealed format whose set list is limited to the sets in its product.<ref name="pc-slt" /><ref name="slt" /><ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" />

The Players Committee's ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' lists paper sealed formats with the same product: ''Premiere Sealed'' (one Premiere Starter Deck) and ''OTSD Sealed'' and ''OTSD Booster Draft'' (one Official Tournament Sealed Deck).<ref name="afg" /> No source links the GEMP league to them, and no league result in this format is recorded.
